Victoria Zaharoff is a Human weapons dealer.


Personality
An ultra-rationalist, only acting on calculated gains. Observant, sharp, confident and cool. She has an eye for a good deal and money, and is sexually open and powerful.

Because of her background, she is a woman of strong character, and she has quickly distinguished with her ability to keep a cool head in any situation. Believes that supplying both sides with the same level of firepower could create peace. Although she is often criticized for her appearance, she uses this to his advantage to gather information. Because of her skill people around her fear her as the "The god of death who spreads war".

Appearance
She has long blond hair and blue eyes.

History
Background
Victoria is a black market broker from the UFS, she sells weapons to anyone she meets.

She claims that he can provide everything from nuclear weapons to legendary magic swords, as long as she has the money to do so. She is the only daughter of the Don of a mafia family that died out. When she was a child, her entire family was killed in a gang war, and she was the only one to escape thanks to the help of her family's inner circle.

After that, while studying the arms and drug markets, she came to the conclusion that "if we equalize the world's military forces, there would be no more fighting", and she became an arms broker. Known as the "The god of death who spreads war" she is marked by many organizations, but no organization can mess with her. Victoria is aware of this, so she is free to go out on her own and go sightseeing in between business meetings. However, she always has the latest weapons hidden inside her coat, and if something were to happen, she would annihilate the enemy without mercy.

As the largest war merchant dealing in magical tools, magical beasts and magical mercenaries, she is reaping huge profits.

Timeline TABA
In her "what if" event, she made a deal with the Fuuma Organization for weapons but wanted to be convinced of Fuuma Kotaro (TABA)'s strength. The follow-up confirms that she after this had a partnership with the Fuuma Organization.

Main Weapon: Multiple Guns

Trivia
Her name hints at her Russia connection also, because the game just mentions the UFS is her base of operation but not her home.
